Subject: Guidelines for Extension of Approval (EoA) for BBA/BMS/BCA programs for the
Academ ic Y ear 2026-27 -reg.
As per the provisions outlined in the Approval Process Handbook ZO24-ZT, all
institutions/universities/deemed-to-be universities offering BBA/BMS/BCA programs are required
to seek approval from the All lndia council for Technical Education (AlcrE).
To facilitate the grant of Extension of Approval (EoA) for the Academic Year 2026-27, the
processing of applications from BBA/BMS/BCA institutions will follow a structured procedure. This
includes a comprehensive scrutiny of documents and facilities, followed by a review by the
Standing Appellate Committee (SAC), if applicable.
Please note that for any increase in intake compared to the previous academic year (2025-26),
institutions must demonstrate additionalfaculty and infrastructure, proportionate to the increased
intake.
All institutions must adhere to the norms and procedures specified in the Approval process
Handbook 2024-27 to ensure compliance with AICTE requirements.
This notification has been issued with the approval of the Competent Authority, AICTE.
